Grand Theft Auto 6’s HDR Is Broken, But These Tweaks Can Fix It

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (864 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Gamespot

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles.
  • Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles.
  • It has been revealed that that's due to an HDR calibration tool that isn't exactly working in the way that you expect it.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Grand Theft Auto VI is a visual and audial treat, and is easily one of the most technically impressive games on the current generation of consoles. But it isn't without challenges, especially if you're trying to experience the sights and sounds of Vice City with all the moody contrast and bright highlights that HDR offers. That's due to an HDR calibration tool that isn't exactly working in the way that you expect it. Like many other games, GTA VI doesn't use the system-level HDR settings on either the PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S. Instead it features its own calibration tool, which lets you adjust the maximum brightness, black levels, and paper white values that work best on your display. While the tool makes calibration seem straightforward, there's an issue with it that makes it very unreliable. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d3UaVoP6dPg Specifically, the maximum brightness and paper white point values seem to be linked in a way that is both unclear and incorrect. Normally you would set these values individually, with maximum brightness set according to the value your display supports and the paper white value that looks best to you. GTA VI instead changes the maximum peak brightness value it is storing as you change the paper white point. For example, if you set a maximum peak brightness at 1000 nits (a typical value) but then reduce the paper white point (given how how its default is), the peak brightness value reduces as well, with no indication to you that it's happening. HDR enthusiasts and handy calibration assistors HDTVTest and GamingTech have both confirmed the issue, and provided some rough workarounds until Rockstar (hopefully) releases a fix. The idea is setting the maximum brightness value higher than your display supports, but in line with what the game is expecting based on the paper white point value to choose. It's confusing, but GamingTech has drawn up a table that might help depending on your display's specifications. HDTVTest's approach is similar but with different recommended values for both the ideal paper white point and black level values, so you'll need to do some experimenting on your end to find what suits your setup best. Rockstar has released the first patch for GTA VI, but it mostly addresses some widespread bugs that players have been encountering since launch. HDR issues were also common at launch with Red Dead Redemption 2 but eventually were fixed sometime after, but if you're like 45 million other people and planning to explore Leonida today, then hopefully these tweaks let you get it looking its finest.

HDR enthusiasts and handy calibration assistors HDTVTest and GamingTech have both confirmed the issue, and provided some rough workarounds until Rockstar (hopefully) releases a fix. The idea is setting the maximum brightness value higher than your display supports, but in line with what the game is expecting based on the paper white point value to choose. It's confusing, but GamingTech has drawn up a table that might help depending on your display's specifications. HDTVTest's approach is similar but with different recommended values for both the ideal paper white point and black level values, so you'll need to do some experimenting on your end to find what suits your setup best.

Rockstar has released the first patch for GTA VI, but it mostly addresses some widespread bugs that players have been encountering since launch. HDR problems were also common at launch with Red Dead Redemption 2 but eventually were fixed sometime after, but if you're like 45 million other people and planning to explore Leonida today, then hopefully these tweaks let you get it looking its finest.

The newest episode of St. Denis Medical took a shocking turn with a surprise onscreen split — but does that mean Ariana Madix has officially left the show?

It has been revealed that during the Monday, November 23, episode of the NBC series, Brooke (Madix) accepted a upcoming job, marking the end of her romance with Bruce (Josh Lawson). Us subsequently asked creator Eric Ledgin whether the story line had reached its natural conclusion — or if it was a result of Madix’s busy schedule.

Industry observers note that “I think both can be true. [Bruce] was certainly too much for [Brooke]. Too much or not enough, I’m not sure. Maybe both of those are true as well,” Ledgin exclusively told Us. “But I think we’re just trying to make the most entertaining, funny and logical choices for the characters in the stories we’re telling.”.

Ledgin knew Bruce’s personal life had to take a turn, adding, “For me, Bruce had to be crushed, and it just had to happen. It reverberates throughout the season for him. Bruce has a lot of growing to do. I think as a person, often the way that growth happens is from being hurt and so it just made a lot of sense for the character.”.

Recent findings suggest that he continued, “And Ariana is so lovely and funny and we would love to have her back. It’s certainly not off the table for the character to make an appearance again.”.

St. Denis Medical, which premiered in 2024, follows overworked doctors and nurses trying their best to care for patients at an underfunded Oregon hospital. Madix, 41, joined the show in season 2 as Bruce’s ex Brooke, who works at the same place as him and who later got back together with the surgeon.

“I’ve done guest spots before, but this is my first recurring role and it’s been really exciting because I feel like that trajectory of scripted is something that I started a very, very long time ago,” Madix explained to Us in April. “Maybe before Vanderpump Rules. So I feel as though it feels like coming home — in a sense — of being able to pick that back up and also be able to be a part of such an amazing show.”.

Madix’s opportunity on the sitcom felt extra special since she was already a fan.

Industry observers note that “St Denis is one of the best demonstrates that we have going on — especially for comedies — on TV right now,” she remarked. . “It’s the type of show that I’ve always wanted to be a part of. For them to have me around for a few episodes and be able to play this recurring character? Honestly, it’s been really, really awesome.”.

At the time, Madix didn’t rule out another return in the future.

“I would love to come back. I had such an amazing time. I’ve always dreamed of the day I get to do what I love and make a living doing it,” she stated. “I would love to see what Brooke is like outside of that hospital.”.

As for whether Us‘ pitch for a Brooke spinoff was too rich to pass up, Madix replied, “Maybe one day.”.

For now, Madix isn’t expected to appear in more episodes in season 3. Ledgin, however, had ideas for other potential reality cameos.

Rockstar Games and parent firm Take-Two are riding high currently from the success of Grand Theft Auto 6 with a reported 45 million copies sold and $4 billion in revenue already, but this could just the beginning of how much money GTA 6 could bring in. According to Bank of America stock analyst Omar Dessouky, the initial success of GTA 6 reinforces the company's belief that the game has a massive reach, and with that comes the possibility of monetizing the players even more when the next evolution of GTA Online is released.

In fact, SeekingAlpha reported that Dessouky remarked he is so bullish that he believes GTA Online alone "can become a multibillion-dollar franchise, potentially larger than Fortnite." He said Fortnite generates as much as $5 billion in annual revenue, and GTA Online could be bigger in the fullness of time.

In a recent development, the stock analyst went on to raise his price target on Take-Two's stock to $350. That would represent a significant upside, considering Take-Two at the moment trades at around $210/share.

It has been revealed that take-Two's stock got hammered in 2026 and never fully recovered. The company's shares are down 16% so far in 2026 and down 12% over the past year.

Investing is a long-term game, though. Zooming out, Take-Two has crushed it since GTA 5 released. If you bought $10,000 worth of Take-Two stock on the day GTA 5 came out in 2013, and never sold, you'd have more than $120,000 today.

In a recent development, as for the next iteration of GTA Online, Rockstar has not said a word about what to expect or if such a mode is even coming. GTA 6, after all, is marketed as a strictly single-player game.

That being remarked, it seems plainly obvious that a new version of GTA Online is coming. According to multiple reports, the new version of GTA Online for GTA 6 could launch in 2027, along with a PC edition of the game.

GTA Online for GTA 5 has been, and continues to this day, to be a major moneymaker for Rockstar and Take-Two, and it's expected that the developer will find even more ways to make money from players with GTA 6 Online. Some have theorized that GTA 6 Online could have some form of user-generated content, for example, potentially leading to a marketplace of some kind.

Sources indicate that GTA 6 introduced on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it reached 32.5 million copies sold via pre-purchases alone. 📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Billy Ray Cyrus is one proud dad following his daughter Miley Cyrus and her husband Maxx Morando‘s intimate Palm Springs wedding.

According to recent reports, “My little girl married the love of her life! I can’t describe how beautiful it felt to have all my family together in one room, united by love,” the “Achy Breaky Heart” musician, 65, wrote to Miley via a Monday, November 23, Instagram post. “@miley words can’t begin to express how proud you make me every day… I’m the proudest dad alive!!”.

Billy Ray and his girlfriend, Elizabeth Hurley — who have recently sparked their own engagement rumors — were in attendance when Miley, 34, and Morando, 28, tied the knot at the late Frank Sinatra‘s former Twin Palms estate in California on Saturday, November 21.

The singer paid tribute to his fresh son-in-law as well on Monday, writing to Morando, “@mmaxxm I’m so honored to welcome you to the family! The two of you kids are a match made in heaven.”.

Miley has a double milestone to celebrate this week, as she also turned 34 on Monday, a mere two days after she exchanged vows with Morando. (The “Let’s Get Married” singer was previously wed to Liam Hemsworth from 2018 to 2020.).

“Happy, happy birthday Miley – I can’t wait to keep celebrating you both today and forever,” Billy Ray added.

Earlier, he told TMZ that the best part of attending Miley’s wedding was “knowing that the love is going to last forever.”.

Asked whether he walked his daughter down the aisle, Billy Ray simply noted, “It was a beautiful ceremony.”.

Us previously reported that Miley was walked down the aisle by her mother, Tish Cyrus, who attended the nuptials with her husband, Dominic Purcell. (Miley’s sisters, Noah Cyrus and Brandi Cyrus, were both in attendance, as was Liz’s son Damian Hurley.).

“It was a really intimate wedding, and there weren’t any big celebrity guests outside of her family,” a source exclusively told Us, adding, “It wasn’t a typical Hollywood or traditional wedding, but was everything Miley wanted.”.

The Hannah Montana actress broke her silence on Sunday, November 23, by sharing a carousel of photos from her special day. She subsequently thanked her team for pulling off the glamorous ceremony while acknowledging that her wedding coincided with another major milestone.

Recent findings suggest that “Waking up on my 34th birthday feeling so grateful,” she wrote via Instagram on Monday. “Thank you for all the wishes & to everyone who made this weekend a memory we’ll cherish for a lifetime and beyond.”.

Miley and Morando started seeing each other after being set up on a blind date in 2021. In addition to their romance, the former Regrettes drummer was credited as a producer on Miley’s 2023 album Endless Summer Vacation.

Us confirmed in December 2025 that Cyrus and Morando were engaged when she was spotted at the Avatar: Fire and Ash premiere in Los Angeles wearing a cushion cut diamond ring set in a 14K yellow gold band, designed by Jacquie Aiche.
